key_insight: Streaming Pauli Correlation Encoding (PCE) outperforms Buy & Hold in the reported evaluations while using far fewer qubits than one per asset.
engineering_relevance: PCE offers a more practical scaling path than joint multi-cut dPCE for rolling portfolio rebalancing, with lower resource growth and less sensitivity to rebalancing frequency.
method: Encode asset-correlation clustering with Pauli correlations to reduce qubit requirements.
Re-estimate correlations and portfolios on rolling windows using PCE and joint multi-cut dPCE.
Vary rebalancing cadence, risk aversion, transaction costs, and measurement-shot budgets.
evidence_signal: Across tests with portfolios up to several thousand assets, both streaming variants consistently beat Buy & Hold; during a downturn, PCE lost markedly less than the baseline.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish quantum advantage over strong active classical strategies or specify quantum hardware execution conditions.
paper_title: Large-Scale Streaming Portfolio Optimization with Pauli Correlation Encoding
